templates.title: Odoo Backup
templates.description: Daily Odoo backup: dump.sql + filestore in one Odoo-compatible zip, with retention
templates.note: Runs next to an existing Odoo stack. Find the values with tools/discover.sh from https://github.com/erikoindra/odoo-backup-service. Pick the image that matches your PostgreSQL server major version.

env.name: IMAGE
env.label: PostgreSQL server version
env.description: pg_dump must match the server major version

env.name: PGHOST
env.label: Database host
env.description: PostgreSQL container name or alias on the database network

env.name: PGUSER
env.label: Database user
env.description: The Odoo database user is enough (no superuser needed)

env.name: DB_NETWORK
env.label: Database network
env.description: Existing Docker network that the PostgreSQL container is on

env.name: ODOO_DATA_VOLUME
env.label: Odoo data volume
env.description: Existing volume mounted at Odoo's data_dir (usually /var/lib/odoo)

env.name: DB_NAME
env.label: Database name(s)
env.description: Comma separated. Empty: every database that has a filestore folder

env.name: TZ
env.label: Time zone
env.description: For the schedule and file names, e.g. Asia/Jakarta

env.name: BACKUP_VOLUME
env.label: Backup volume
env.description: Volume the zips are written to (created if missing)
